labels.label: bzthm:c2s3t1_poche_balayable
labels.notes: Unmarked (l.11 writes `bzthm:c2s3t1_poche_balayable` with no ** mark, grep '\*\*`bz' finds nothing), REPORT status partial, ledger row partial, OQ-71 left open: correct, since the full form of 1 deg c is proved only in cases. Checked against benzecri1960_ch2.tex l.517-533 (statement), l.582-590 (1 deg c), l.600-603 (3 deg), l.188-190 (Def. 2); the docstring quotes match the transcription verbatim and the cited lines are right. (i) isCoqueProj_of_le_one_proj: its hypotheses are hn : n <= 1 and hP : IsPocheProj P l phi z only (it even omits HasGroupoid; no PreconnectedSpace, no balayable), and its conclusion is the strict IsCoqueProj P l phi z = IsPocheProj /\ Sphere.IsConvexPart (phi '' P), i.e. Def. 2's shell, not a variant. The argument is sound: phi(P) is the continuous image of the connected P, lies in the open hemisphere, which is affinely isomorphic to R^n (n <= 1) by an open embedding, so it is an interval or a point, hence affinely convex, hence a convex part by the strict Sphere.isConvexPart_iff_isAffConvex. So every pocket is a shell for n <= 1, and theoremePrinted_of_le_one_proj is the strict TheoremePrinted n (the printed Theorem, full form of 1 deg, 2 deg-4 deg) for n <= 1. n = 1 is non-vacuous with P /= V and a non-constant cote (poche_eq_preimage_demiDroite_le_one_proj). n = 0 is non-vacuous (strict theoreme_poche_balayable_model at n = 0, a pocket of the sweepable R^0) but degenerate and not disclosed: H is one point, every cote is constant, so z = 0 and P = V (strict poche_eq_preimage_of_cote_eq_zero); see the minor finding. (iii) poche_eq_preimage_of_coque_proj goes through theoreme_troisieme, whose statement carries no full-form hypothesis and whose proof (deux_points_dans_poche, existsUnique_smul_eq) never touches 1 deg c; only .1 of IsStrictConvexPart (convexity) is used. Its hypotheses (IsCoqueProj, IsDeveloping, EqOn) are satisfiable, witnessed with P /= V and z not = 0 by poche_eq_preimage_demiDroite_coque_proj; nothing trivialises it. The paper's own 3 deg proof (l.600-603) also uses only 1 deg a-b (phi~ injective, l.591-592) and Prop. 7's corollary, so the REPORT's no-circularity finding is true. The companion theoreme_poche_balayable_coque_proj and TheoremeCoquePrinted are the assembly restricted to shells, named as such; theoreme_poche_balayable is untouched. (ii) poche_eq_preimage_of_starConvex_proj assumes star-shapedness in H's affine structure (Def. 6) only for y in range p over H, about c with z c < 1; c in range p is derived. This is weaker than the S(n) reading (closedSeg c y subset range p for all y in range p), since segments between points of H are their affine segments, so the lemma is the stronger one, as the REPORT says; the reading and the fact that (ii) is not a hypothesis of the paper are disclosed (docstring l.41, l.79, l.91; REPORT questions). OQ-71 sharpened: ConnexeOuvertPrinted n is ConnexePrinted n restricted to not-a-shell, P /= univ, and no c with z c < 1 about which range p over H is star-shaped, i.e. exactly the complement of the settled cases (shells, which contain n <= 1; P = V, which contains z = 0; star-shaped, which contains the convex cases). connexePrinted_iff_ouvert_proj: -> is weakening, <- is a real case analysis on the three proved cases; theoremePrinted_iff_ouvert_proj composes it with the strict theoremePrinted_iff. Both true, kernel-checked, not trivial. The coarse wording « open only for a non-shell pocket with a non-constant cote, in n >= 2 » is correct as a necessary condition: not-a-shell is a restriction, P /= V forces z not = 0 (not_cote_eq_zero_of_ne_univ_proj), and the open case is empty for n <= 1 (connexeOuvertPrinted_of_le_one_proj). The REPORT's five findings about the paper were each checked and are true; none asserts an error in the paper. Its observation that the paper never notes the n <= 1 reduction holds (no dimension-1 remark in benzecri1960_ch2.tex).

findings.what: The hypothesis checklist writes « ✓ » on rows that are added restrictions relative to 1 deg's full form, which the paper asserts for every pocket in every dimension: l.78 (« ✓ every n for (ii), (iii) and P = V; n ≤ 1 for (i) »), l.80 (« une coque » is the hypothesis of 3 deg, but an added hypothesis for the full form in (iii)) and l.81 (« ✓ carried, full form … in these cases only »). The (ii) row (l.79) has no ⚠ marker, though the REPORT marks it « strengthened ». kb 0006 reserves ✓ for carried and ⚠ strengthened for a theorem assuming more. Everything is disclosed in SCOPE and the row is unmarked and partial, so nothing is overclaimed; the checklist is not literally true as written.
findings.fix: At graduation: l.78 « ⚠ strengthened for (i): n ≤ 1 (SCOPE) »; l.79 « ⚠ strengthened: a sufficient condition, not the paper's »; l.80 keep ✓ for 3 deg and add « ⚠ strengthened as a hypothesis of 1 deg c's full form »; l.81 « ⚠ strengthened: the full form in these cases only (SCOPE) ».

findings.what: The n = 0 half of (i) (theoremePrinted_of_le_one_proj, connexePrinted_of_le_one_proj, premierPrinted_of_le_one_proj) is non-vacuous (strict theoreme_poche_balayable_model at n = 0) but degenerate, and this is not said: at n = 0 the hemisphere is a point, every cote is constant, condition a forces z = 0, and P = V by poche_eq_preimage_of_cote_eq_zero, which the strict library already had. The new content of (i) is n = 1. Neither the file nor the REPORT says so.
findings.fix: Add to SCOPE: « For n = 0, H̊ is a point, so z ≡ 0 and P = V (poche_eq_preimage_of_cote_eq_zero): (i) adds only n = 1, witnessed by poche_eq_preimage_demiDroite_le_one_proj. »

findings.what: The title « for every shell, in every dimension `n ≤ 1`, and when … » can be read as « for every shell in every dimension n ≤ 1 », which understates (iii) (every shell, every n) and hides that (i) covers every pocket. Wording only.
findings.fix: « … where it is proved: for every shell (every n), for every pocket in dimension n ≤ 1, and when φ̃(V) ∩ H̊ is star-shaped about a point of cote < 1 ».
